content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | TSF Investments Limited (NSE: TSFINV) TSF Investments Limited (formerly Sundaram Finance Holdings) announces standalone financial results for Q2 FY27. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details (Q2 FY27): - Total Income: ₹42.26 Cr - Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹37.76 Cr - Profit Before Tax: ₹39.71 Cr 🔹 Key Details (H1 FY27): - Total Income: ₹240.23 Cr - Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹214.32 Cr 📌 What happened: ↳ The Board of Directors approved the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during the meeting held on November 11, 2026. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Cupid Limited Reports 133% YoY Net Profit Growth in Q2 FY27
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company reported significant YoY growth in revenue and net profit for Q2 and H1 FY27.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Cupid Limited (NSE: CUPID) Cupid Limited reports strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details (Q2 FY27): - Total Income: ₹208.97 Cr (up 132% YoY) - Net Profit: ₹56.22 Cr (up 133% YoY) - EBITDA: ₹54.77 Cr - Net Profit Margin: 30% 🔹 Key Details (H1 FY27): - Total Income: ₹365.95 Cr (up 136% YoY) - Net Profit: ₹100.37 Cr (up 156% YoY) 📌 What happened: ↳ The company reported significant growth in both domestic and international segments, with domestic business contributing 67% of H1 sales. Cupid has also provided forward-looking revenue and profit guidance for FY27, FY28, and FY29. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: SEPC Limited reports Q2 FY27 financial results
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company reported quarterly financial results including revenue and profit figures.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | SEPC Limited (NSE: SEPC) SEPC Limited reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Total Income: Rs 23,202.05 Lakhs - Net Loss: Rs 5,854.02 Lakhs - EPS: Not disclosed in summary 📌 What happened: ↳ SEPC Limited has released its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, as approved by the Board of Directors. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Popular Vehicles and Services Q2FY27 Results
content_feed.worthiness_reason: The filing provides specific financial performance metrics including Total Income and EBITDA for Q2FY27.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Popular Vehicles and Services Limited (NSE: PVSL) Popular Vehicles and Services reports Q2FY27 financial results ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Total Income: Rs 2,093.8 Cr (up ~36% YoY) - EBITDA: Rs 77.7 Cr - EBITDA Margin: 3.7% - New Vehicles Volume: 19,052 units (up ~46.4% YoY) 📌 What happened: ↳ The company reported a 36% year-on-year growth in total income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by volume growth across passenger, commercial, and electric vehicle segments. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
